text:
Blessed be you, because you made me

love death, which before I feared.

Since you went away from my side,

I love death when I am sad;

if I am joyful, still more.


In other times, its glacial scythe

gave me terrors; today, it is a friend.

And I sense it so maternal!...

You performed such a prodigy.

God bless you! God bless you!

translation.title: Blessed Be You, Because You Made Me...
translation.editorial_note: This related version keeps the same blessing and changed relationship to death.
